subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land the focused fresh-session fallback now, or wait for the broader reattach-first behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The code fixes the same-session transcript collision, but it intentionally preserves the timeout-style two-run boundary for accepted disconnects, which can duplicate model calls, tool side effects, and delivery.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style fallback boundary for this edge case, fix the CLI docs, and leave reattach-first/no-recook behavior to the open product issue.

options.title: Extend this PR to reattach-first
options.body: Fold the broader product direction into this PR so accepted disconnects try to recover the authoritative gateway result before local fallback.

options.title: Pause until product direction is chosen
options.body: Keep the branch open but unmerged until maintainers decide whether recook-first is acceptable for accepted disconnects.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style fallback boundary for this edge case, fix the CLI docs, and leave reattach-first/no-recook behavior to the open product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent agent CLI/gateway dispatch history makes this the best available owner for the fallback behavior choice.
